Read only; nothing changed, no tests or builds run.
in_one_paragraph: The separation of reasoning, situation and where they meet holds: the atlas already stores it (dynamics.json, situations.json, bindings.json) and 08 §9 already says it. The figure of things holds, and so does the word rule. What breaks is "lines and four marks are the map's whole vocabulary". In the root a mark is a position of an occurrence under a class, and the draft's line record has no class; in Lean, 生 under a determination's class is a change in either direction, so a formation's ceasing is a 生. By my reading of 76 rows of region one, about four in ten general laws conclude a mark; in families A and D, 8 of 23 do. The law that closes the meta-attractor's loop is an order between two runs, which IF-marks-THEN-mark cannot state. Line and mark words occur in 36 of 401 Lean modules, so on such a map most law records would be AI readings of the Lean. "One set of lines" asserts samenesses that the Lean joins only by reading, exactly where region one crosses from the rule models to the web models. And of the three things said to be able to fail, the data shows only the bridge failing. I would build the store on the alternative below (one web, distinctions, ledger premises, several law forms, one kind of joint) and keep the draft's four questions as the reader's legend.

findings.what: A mark is a position under a class; the draft's line record has no class, and without one 'what makes it form' has no fixed answer.
findings.evidence: 01 §3: 'Under a class E, an occurrence begins (生) where it continues nothing'. sheng_iff_change: 生 under the class of a determination p holds exactly where ComesToBe p or CeasesToBe p. Web.ceases_iff_inactive_sheng: 'A formation ceasing is the beginning (生), at the next step, of a line of inactivity'. Web.flash_positions: one occurrence abides under 一 and begins and ends under 静 and under activity.
findings.so: Asked of a formation under the class of activity, 'what makes it 生' has the formation's ceasing among its answers. The record needs a class and which side of it; that is r7's question-with-answers, not a line at a mark.

findings.what: What laws conclude is mostly not 01's marks but 02's courses, and placing a point is not always decidable.
findings.evidence: locked_stays concludes '∀ k, Locked …'; lock_line concludes «不穷». 住 is local: 'something precedes and something follows it'. 02 §1: placing every point in 生成, 后守 or 退化 'is exactly excluded middle'; 'The boundary between going on and ending is where a line's going on is not decided'.
findings.so: 'Lasts' and 'ends' on the map should be 延, 不穷, 尽, 有终, said of a line from a point on. Every cell needs a third value, 'not decided', alongside holds and fails.

findings.what: 'Changes' is not a fourth state. It needs two classes, and one line lasts and alters at the same step.
findings.evidence: 'Altering is a relation between two occurrences with a finer class, not a mark of one occurrence'. lock_line: the line never ends under lockedAlike and every step is «异» under sameValue loss. The draft's own example place, 'the rule's lean lasts; the stock it does not go by is ending', is in Lean one course read under two classes; the 'stock' is a counter (Accrues fB, b : Nat) that nothing lives on and that never ends.
findings.so: A place written as marks on separate things turns positions into states of things, and here says more than the Lean: no stock, no ending. Whether something ended or changed depends on the sameness chosen; the map should make the reader choose it.

findings.what: A relation's holding is a line in some models and not in others; the draft drops the field that said which.
findings.evidence: Proved: 'W.Dissolves t f c ↔ W.requires t f c ∧ «亡» Steps.next (Steps.alike (W.requires · f c)) t'. Not a line: 'def ReadsShare (P) (M) (h : S → R → R) : Prop', a property of the rebuilding function with no step in it. r7 typed its eleven questions setup 6, state 4, clock 1.
findings.so: 'Their eleven questions are lines, and their answers are marks' holds for 4 of 11 (held, ways, there, on). The other seven are ties assumed for the whole course, amount comparisons (pays), an order of two times (time), or who fills a role (judges).

findings.what: The root's own set of questions is not the draft's four, and the draft leaves out constancy and the core.
findings.evidence: 01: 'Every later chapter reads its subject as continuation relative to some class: which relation, which class, at which grain, constant or not.' 08 §9 repeats it as the reading's 'one set of questions'. The meta-attractor's defining property is a constancy statement: ClosedCapture.constant_iff_unread, 'constant under the two-level step along every schedule exactly where nothing beyond the share is read'.
findings.so: About a fifth of region one's general laws say 'this does not tell that apart' (类, 有常, 核). The draft's vocabulary has no word for them, though the root does.

findings.what: The law that closes the meta-attractor's loop is an order between two runs, and the stored loop has links no general law carries.
findings.evidence: The row's note: 'the link from held back to removed that closes this dynamic's loop, and the only general law here tying how far ahead to how much is used up', shape none. Loop link 'held to draws: down, moves' matches 0 rows: the lock laws take the using-up as given (ledger premise closedcapture-accrues). Link 'draws: down to there: removed' has one built example (ReadingsSpread.Commons.cleared_spreads) and one reading with no law.
findings.so: Drawn as IF-marks-THEN-mark, the centre of the concern either drops its one general law or asserts two links as laws. This is where the map's own reasoning can be wrong while the Lean is right.

findings.what: The IF side is mostly not marks either.
findings.where: atlas/entries/premises.json (1,669 premises; I read a random 28); situations.json
findings.evidence: Of 28: about 7 are a determination holding over steps (flow-below-from-t, learning-rests); 8 compare amounts; 7 are shapes of the step law (regimemargin-coupled-part-keeps-order); 4 are commitments of the representation or decidability; 2 concern a pair of courses. In the one situation, 6 of 40 premises are assessed as 'a hypothesis selecting the pairs of candidates the law speaks of, not a property of the pipeline'.
findings.so: A case record of 'sightings (line, mark, when)' cannot assess most premises. Shapes of the step law need a response to a varied input; alike-laws need a contrast of two courses, as CG1's C1 was (own 100% of 118, coupled 0% of 2,360).

findings.what: Line and marks are the literal vocabulary of under a tenth of the Lean.
findings.evidence: «相续» or any mark occurs in 36 of 401 modules, «际» in 55, the World's Web, Flow and level in 172. Dynamics by base: World 65, named model 38, any type 37, any process 15, periphery 11, none 9, root 8. 08 §7: of 117 central declarations 11 are derived from the grammar, 32 have balance in their statements, 18 are on amounts. 08 §9: 'Of the 3,700 laws read, 885 reach a grammar constant and 331 reach continuation itself.'
findings.so: On a lines-and-marks map most law records are AI readings of a theorem in other words. That weakens the thing Ren asked for: knowing when the logic shown is the logic checked. The account concedes amounts are not carried ('failing on its amounts', 01 thesis), yet the draft's t3 and r4 are amounts.

findings.what: One list of lines asserts samenesses the Lean joins only by reading, exactly where region one crosses islands.
findings.where: dynamics.json compose entries (10: 6 proved, 3 reading, 1 stated); Lean imports
findings.evidence: Shared by definition: RuleCapture, ClosedCapture, RuleShaping, DrawnShaping, ReadInTime, PoolFromCourse, PairSelection (Locked, ReadsShare, CarrierCounts). A separate island: BeyondCoupling, ReadOffInTime, Optimum (levels, needs, couplings). The joins between them are the non-proved ones: unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure to readers-drawn-from-the-selected (reading), to the-lock-draws-its-readers-out (reading, both laws null), reading-a-loss-in-time to loss-read-in-time-by-the-others (reading), readings-revised-spread-and-locked to the-lock-draws-its-readers-out (stated).
findings.so: 't7 a rule' and 't3 what it lives on' as single lines identify ReadsShare with SelectsThrough and a counter with a level. Sameness across models should be its own record with how far it is seen. The compose entries already have that shape (from.role, to.role, map, joint_law, standing).

findings.what: 'Three things can each be wrong' is not what the data shows: only the bridge fails, and by construction.
findings.evidence: Of 11 detailed bindings: 'the binding' 6, 'nothing failed' 5, 'the law' 0, 'the measurement' 0. LA3: 'MA3's laws are theorems and the test cannot refute them; what failed is the identification'. 08 §9: 'a conclusion failing in a domain shows that the domain does not meet the hypotheses or that the correspondence misreads them, not that the theorem is false. A thesis claiming that the domain meets them does fail there.'
findings.so: What can be wrong on the reasoning side is the thesis, an argued step, or the map's own rendering of a law (r7's second reader refuted 50 of 193 typings). The map should count, per law, how many bridges were tried and how many held with every premise met; today that number is near zero.

findings.what: A Lean witness is reasoning in how far it is seen and a case in shape; counted with actual cases it would swamp them.
findings.evidence: 160 of 321 exits and 35 of 193 r7 rows are witnesses. 145 ledger premises list a witness under holds_in, 124 under fails_in. The one stored situation is 'kind: model, standing: reading' and says 'the graph has no time'. Observed webs stored: none; tests bound in detail: 11.
findings.so: Two distinctions are hiding in 'reasoning or situation': general or particular, and proved, observed or said. Law is general and proved; witness particular and proved; actual case particular and observed; thesis general and about the actual. Draw built and observed differently, always.

findings.what: A reading of a tradition's sentence is a joint between two reasonings; 'names' is too thin for it.
findings.evidence: Each entry has sense, quote, source.basis, relation (scope 371, agreement 338, divergence 325, contrary-reading 25, none 124), reading, targets, account_adds, source_adds.
findings.so: It has the same three parts as a test: what the source says (which can be misquoted: basis is recall or read-in-repo), the interpretation, and the law it is set beside. It is a meeting whose other end is a claim, not a course of events. Aliases are names; these are not.

findings.what: 'A thesis is a meeting claimed for a whole kind of case' fits five of eight theses.
findings.where: 08-METHOD.md §9 table; bindings.json EW2, EW3, EW4, IN1
findings.evidence: T1, T3, T5, T6, T7 each say a kind of actual case meets a proved law's premises. T2 is a class named for a domain (08 §9: 'T2 has this form'). T4 has no law behind it (IN1: 'forecasts about these models, not consequences of the laws'). T8 is 'argued; its test named, not designed'. EW2 to EW4 are bound with 'laws: []'. The two philosophical theses forbid 'explanations, not observations'.
findings.so: A thesis needs to be able to carry no law, and to be of the alike form (T2). It is the one reasoning-side record a test can refute, so it should be visible as such.

findings.what: One picture is honest at the grain of the figure, not at the grain 'every law is a tie between lines'.
findings.evidence: Region one's 193 rows by question: held 64, ways 26, pays 19, reach 12, on 10, there 9, counts 8, time 6, draws 5, source 3, judges 2, none 29. By exits 73 of 183 dynamics touch another; by a shared specific ledger premise 144 of 183 do (675 pairs), though 1,297 of 1,669 premises are used in one dynamic only.
findings.so: A person would first see a thick lock and nearly bare ties around it, which is true and worth drawing. The oneness comes from the figure and the shared premises. The 52 dynamics on any type or any process are about any course and have no place on a figure of things; they are the legend.

findings.where: GLOSSARY.md; 08-METHOD.md §2 'Words in one sense'; bindings.json keys
findings.evidence: The glossary gives 生 as 'the mark begins', 住 'abides', 异 'alters'; the draft says forms, lasts, changes. 07 already uses 'what can form' for admission, so 'forms' gets two senses. bindings.json uses 'marks' and 'marks_why' for where a failure falls. The account already calls the bridge a binding (atlas), a correspondence (08 §9), a bridge hypothesis (tests) and a map (compose); 'meeting' is a fifth. The Chinese glossary has 取用 and 给予, not 取 and 给.
findings.so: The rule 'no word that fits only persons' holds in the draft's list. Use begins, goes on, alters, ends; pick one existing word for the bridge.

holds:
1. Reasoning, situation and where they meet, as three kinds of record. This needs no invention. dynamics.json is the reasoning. situations.json writes a case as a web with role-to-thing pairs and each premise assessed. bindings.json writes a test meeting a law with roles, premises (met 22, not checked 15, failed 5), observed, result, where a failure falls, and an alternative. 08 §9 states the principle. What is missing is coverage: 22 of 66 tests bound, 11 in detail, one situation.

2. The list of things t1 to t9 as one figure. It covers the subject of all eight families and is r7's 'who is who' without the person words. As a figure it is one map.

3. A relation's holding as a line, where the relation is a determination along the steps. Proved: Web.dissolves_iff_wang, ceasesToBe_iff_wang (Change.lean).

4. The lock in the root's own words. Proved: ClosedCapture.lock_line and loss_ends_line (GrammarRegularity.lean), cited in 02 §9.

5. A thesis as a meeting claimed for a kind of case: T1, T3, T5, T6, T7.

6. A witness as a built case, as record shape. The ledger already uses witnesses this way (holds_in, fails_in).

7. The four questions as a way in for a reader, where a law does conclude a course. This is strongest for ending laws: 7 of 12 in family A.

8. The word rule. The draft's list has no word that fits only persons.

9. 'Ways of lasting' (at rest, returning, through turnover, growing) matches families G, F, H and 02 §§1 to 4. The root's own three (自持, 因于, 相须; 01 §5) are missing, and they are the typed ties the draft's topology wants.
breaks:
1. 'The map's whole vocabulary is this.' Line and mark words occur in 36 of 401 Lean modules, 8 of 183 dynamics are on the root, and 08 §7 places 11 of 117 central declarations as derived from the grammar. Amounts, which the account says the grammar does not carry, are already in the draft's t3 and r4.

2. 'Of every line the same four things are asked.' A mark has no meaning without a class (sheng_iff_change, ceases_iff_inactive_sheng). 'Changes' is a relation under two classes. 'Lasts' in laws is 不穷 or 延, not 住. And placing can be undecided («三域之定当且仅当排中»).

3. 'Their eleven questions are lines, and their answers are marks.' True of 4 of 11.

4. 'A law says: IF these lines are at these marks THEN that line is at that mark.' About 44% of region one's general laws, 8 of 23 in families A and D, and about a quarter of ledger premises on the IF side. No place for alike-laws, order laws, identities, backward filters, impossibilities or weight bounds; PoolFromCourse.window_order_kept, which closes the loop, is among them.

5. 'One set of lines for the whole account.' Sameness across the rule models and the web models is by reading (3 compose entries reading, 1 stated), and the stored loop has one link with no law and one with a built example only.

6. 'Three things can each be wrong: the law, the observation, the bridge.' In the data only the bridge is ever marked, and a proved law cannot be. The reasoning that can be wrong is the thesis, the argued step and the map's own rendering.

7. 'Situation … what was observed of each line.' Nothing is observed in a witness, and half the atlas's exits are witnesses. Sightings cannot assess premises about the shape of a step or about pairs of courses; the tests that worked were contrasts.

8. 'Names' as the fifth record. The crosswalk's 1,183 entries are claims set beside laws with a relation, not names.

9. 'A thesis is a meeting claimed for a whole kind of case.' Not T2, T4, T8 or the two philosophical theses.

10. Alternatives the task named. 02's regions cannot be the vocabulary: 02 itself says '§§4–9 are not read as regions' and 'the some-branch regions are not read on the World'. The ledger alone is the most faithful and joins more than exits do, but has no picture and no conclusions; it is 'connections between components' again. The situation schema alone has no time ('the graph has no time') and no amounts ('the records write no levels').
better:
Build on the situation schema and the ledger together, with the root's own unit. In short: one web, read by distinctions, with laws in several forms and one kind of joint.

1. Ground: one web. Things and the ties between them: draws on, gives back, lives on, couples into, picks among, is rebuilt from. This is the schema the atlas's one case is already written in (formations, conditions, couplings, readers, rule), plus the two things the World model has and that schema dropped: steps and levels. One thing can stand in two roles. This is the one figure, and it is the relation-first order of 01 §1 ('one kind of symbol, a relation').

2. Unit: a distinction (类), named on a thing or a tie. A respect in which two moments are the same or not: active or not, level at or above the need, the rule favours what it picked, this reaches that. It is r7's question, renamed in the account's word and without the cast. Each carries the root's own four questions (which tie, which sameness, at which grain, whether it holds by itself) and whether it is a state the course can change or a property of the step assumed throughout. Begins, goes on, alters, ends are asked of a distinction, and 'not decided' is an answer.

3. Reasoning: a law is its Lean name, its roles on the web, what it takes (ledger premise ids, unchanged) and what it says, in one of a few forms drawn differently:
   - goes on, is reached, is left (the four questions);
   - a border in amounts or times;
   - alike (this does not reach that: a wall);
   - more gives no less;
   - same as;
   - shows (read backward);
   - cannot.
   A witness is a law about one built web.

4. Situation: a case is an actual web. It records which thing fills which role and what was seen: sightings with time, and also contrasts (two courses differing in one thing) and responses (what moved when something was varied).

5. Joints: one record kind wherever two of these are set against each other.
   - Kinds: a case under a law (a test), a model under a model (compose, case_of, a representation theorem), a kind of case under laws (a thesis), an outside claim beside a law (a crosswalk entry).
   - Each has two ends, a role-to-role map, each premise assessed (met, failed, not checked, not a property of one case), how far the joint is seen (proved in Lean, frozen test, reading, argued), and what failed.
   - Two models' roles are drawn as one place only where the joint is proved; otherwise as two places with a visible seam.

Why this and not the draft:
- Its words are literal for 172 of 401 modules against 36, so more of the map's reasoning is what the checker checked.
- A law and a case share one vocabulary, so meeting them is assessing premises one by one, which the atlas already does 82 times.
- It states 11 of the 12 worked laws without overstating, against 5.
- It answers 'one map' by one figure with its seams shown, not by an identity the Lean lacks.

Keep from the draft: the separation, the figure of things, the word rule, and the four questions as the reader's legend.
